hello.text: Kanna! You finally remember where your mother lives. Have you eaten?

choices.text: Is there any work, Amma? Anything you need?

worry.text: Hmph. You are thinner than last time. Sit, sit.

food.text: Always sambar. Take some home. And call your father once in a while.

favor.text: Your father's old Ambassador has to reach Uncle Raju's garage before he closes. Your father is at the temple and you know he drives like a bullock cart. Can you take it? Don't scratch it.

choices.text: Of course. I'll take it right now.

yes.text: Keys are in the car outside. Uncle Raju closes soon, so go fast but carefully. And take this for petrol.

bye.text: Go, go. Come for dinner on Sunday.

k1.text: Machan! Heard you're doing big things now. Airport, metro, all that.

k2.text: Engineering exams. Again. If you're flying out of Meenambakkam, tell Priya at check-in I said hi.

k3.text: My lips are sealed. For a coffee at Selvi's, maybe.

s1.text: Vanakkam! Filter coffee, strong, less sugar? Or are you here for the other business?

coffee.text: Here. Hot like the afternoon on Mount Road.

dosa.text: Crispy, just how you like it.

work.text: Anand drops packages on the metro for people who pay well. If you want in, find his marker. He hates people who are late.
